# pdf-lib browser runtime

`pdf-lib-1.17.1.min.js` is the unmodified official UMD distribution from the
locally supplied `pdf-lib` package, version 1.17.1 (Andrew Dillon and contributors).

Source: https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib

License: MIT, reproduced in `LICENSE.md`.

The app loads this file only when exporting a PDF. No CDN or network connection
is needed. The project draws pages at 300 dpi using the user's browser fonts so
Chinese text remains legible without installing or redistributing font files.
